title.zh: 给 AI Agent 用的专属基础设施
title.en: Agent-Native Infrastructure (Built for Machines, Not Humans)

old_assumption.zh: 邮箱、浏览器、支付和身份验证都是围绕人类图形界面（GUI）设计的。
old_assumption.en: Email, browsers, payments, and auth are designed around human GUIs.

new_shift.zh: AI Agent 正在成为软件的新一类用户，它们不需要好看的 UI，需要的是极简 API、沙盒与独立身份。
new_shift.en: AI agents are becoming primary software users—they need headless APIs, sandboxes, and machine identities, not pretty dashboards.

zh: 列出 5 个目前完全为人类设计的互联网基础设施（如邮箱、日历、支付、客服），分析当使用者变成 AI Agent 时，原产品的最大摩擦点是什么，以及对应的极简 API 替代品该如何设计。
在 [你的技术栈/熟悉领域] 中，如果要为一个自主运行的 AI Agent 提供安全沙盒和权限审计层，最小的独立开发者 MVP 应该只做哪 3 个核心接口？
en: List 5 internet primitives built for humans (email, calendar, payments, auth) and explain what breaks when the user is an AI agent—plus how a headless API replacement should work.
In [Your Tech Stack/Domain], what are the 3 minimal endpoints needed to build an indie-friendly sandbox and permission layer for autonomous AI agents?

note.zh: 专为 AI Agent 设计的邮箱 API 基础设施
note.en: Email inbox API built specifically for AI agents

note.zh: 为 AI 生成代码提供安全隔离的云端代码沙盒
note.en: Open-source cloud sandboxes for AI-executed code

title.zh: 用完即弃的“一次性定制微软件”

old_assumption.zh: 写软件成本极高，所以每个程序都必须做成通用产品、长期维护并服务成千上万人。
old_assumption.en: Software is expensive to build, so every app must be generalized, maintained for years, and built for thousands.

new_shift.zh: 代码生成成本趋近于零后，为一次旅行、一次搬家或一次数据清洗花 10 分钟生成专属本地网页应用变得完全划算。
new_shift.en: With near-zero code generation cost, spinning up a bespoke local app for one trip, one move, or one dataset is now completely practical.

zh: 我最近需要处理一件一次性但很繁琐的事：[描述你的具体任务]。请帮我设计一个单文件 HTML/JS 本地微工具的极简规格，让我 10 分钟内生成并用完即弃。
盘点 [你的职业/生活场景] 中，哪些原本只能凑合用 Excel 做的临时任务，现在更适合用“一次性定制小网页”彻底解决？
en: I have a tedious one-off task: [Describe Your Task]. Spec out a single-file local HTML/JS micro-app I can generate in 10 minutes, use once, and discard.
In [Your Role/Life Context], which messy tasks people currently hack together in spreadsheets are better solved by disposable, bespoke single-use web apps?

note.zh: “家常软件”概念：只为自己和家人做的小程序
note.en: The classic essay on apps cooked just for yourself and loved ones

title.zh: 本地优先 + 端侧小模型的反云端软件
title.en: Local-First Software Powered by Tiny Edge Models

old_assumption.zh: 智能应用必须把用户数据传到云端、调用昂贵的大模型 API 并收取月度订阅费。
old_assumption.en: Smart apps must upload user data to the cloud, pay cloud LLM APIs, and charge monthly subscriptions.

new_shift.zh: 轻量级端侧视觉/语音/文本模型已经小到能在普通笔记本离线流畅运行，隐私敏感场景迎来“零 API 成本”的一次性买断新机会。
new_shift.en: Tiny open vision/audio/text models now run offline on consumer laptops, unlocking privacy-first, zero-API-cost software.

zh: 列出 5 个用户极度在意隐私、不敢上传云端的 [某领域，如医疗/财务/个人日记] 场景，设计一个完全离线运行、结合端侧小模型的本地优先工具。
对比云端大模型 API 与本地小模型（如 Whisper/Moondream/Qwen 小参数版），在 [具体使用场景] 中，如何通过任务拆解让端侧小模型达到 90% 的可用效果？
en: List 5 privacy-sensitive workflows in [Domain, e.g., finance/health/journaling] where users refuse cloud uploads, and design an offline local-first tool using tiny edge models.
For [Specific Use Case], how can I decompose the task so a small local model (Whisper/Moondream/small LLM) hits 90% accuracy with zero cloud API cost?

note.zh: 极致轻量的开源端侧视觉理解模型，可本地离线运行
note.en: Tiny open-source vision model built to run anywhere on-device

note.zh: Ink & Switch 提出的本地优先软件架构宣言
note.en: Ink & Switch's foundational essay on local-first architecture
